subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should chat slash commands be allowed to archive/delete the active non-main session, and should this PR write new-session names through the current label contract before the title migration lands?
rationale: This is a user-visible destructive session-state command surface that overlaps active session naming migration work, so automation cannot choose the permanent product contract safely.

options.title: Land after parser, proof, and title alignment
options.body: Accept the chat command surface only after catalog-backed `/new` parsing is fixed, the branch is rebased, current-head proof is supplied, and naming is aligned with the chosen label/title contract.

options.title: Land naming only
options.body: Keep explicit named `/new` after the parser fix but defer `/close` and `/delete` to a separate maintainer-owned session deletion decision.

options.title: Pause for canonical PRs
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of the Control UI and canonical title/session-management PRs if maintainers do not want chat-side deletion now.

recommendation.title: Land after parser, proof, and title alignment
recommendation.body: Accept the chat command surface only after catalog-backed `/new` parsing is fixed, the branch is rebased, current-head proof is supplied, and naming is aligned with the chosen label/title contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved product choice intersects the existing `/new` reset behavior and model-selection contract from the history trail.
